claims.claim: An older person must have reached State Pension age to get a bus pass.
claims.quote: In Wales you can get a bus pass when you reach 60.
claims.note: The State Pension age rule applies in England, while Wales allows the pass at 60 and Scotland and Northern Ireland also use 60.

claims.quote: The State Pension age for men and women will now increase to 67 between 2026 and 2028.
claims.note: The age is rising in stages during 2026–2028, so it is not uniformly 66 now.

claims.claim: Some disabled people can qualify for a bus pass before reaching the older-person qualifying age.
claims.quote: You’re eligible for a disabled person’s pass if you live in England and are ‘eligible disabled’.
claims.note: The source confirms a disabled-person route but does not expressly state that it is available before the older-person qualifying age.
